title: noccaea mexicana
intro: Noccaea mexicana, commonly known as Pennyroyal, is a perennial herb belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Noccaea mexicana include its use as a carminative to relieve flatulence and as a diaphoretic to induce sweating, making it beneficial in treating fever and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of Noccaea mexicana include volatile oils, including pulegone, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
